hints.title: Incremental Component Union
hints.text: When adding a land cell, treat it as an isolated component and merge with neighboring land components.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Flat Indexing
hints.text: Map 2D coordinates (r, c) to 1D integer keys r * n + c for union-find operations with rank and path compression.

hints.title: Dynamic Island Count Tracking
hints.text: Maintain parent array initialized to -1. For each position [r, c]: if already land, append current count. Else set parent[id] = id, increment count by one, and check 4 neighbors. For each adjacent land cell, union sets and decrement count on successful merge.

complexity.notes: Optimal dynamic connectivity using union-find with path compression.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-running full grid BFS from scratch for each added position takes O(K * M * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set data structure processes each land addition in almost constant amortized time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle duplicate positions gracefully without re-incrementing the island count.
